artifact/comparison.json.source_identity_parity_required: All producer/source/wheel/SDK/object/runtime/journal/oracle checks must pass before this function is called.
artifact/comparison.json.interpretation: One sealed row-owned candidate only. Publish all null variability and worst pairs; a separated gain does not imply measurement stability. Closed experiments remain unchanged.
artifact/comparison.json.FP_state_evidence: Unchanged frozen harness asserts NumPy policy/handler/buffer and global workers before and after every measured case; this harness does not export separate FP values.

artifact/dispatch-contract.json.hypothesis: STRUCTURAL ONLY: remove fills overwritten by occupied tiles; use one disjoint output-row partition; reduce per-image-row coordinate division; reuse the exact proven stride2 4-byte SIMD operation and scalar constant4-byte memcpy. No claim that helper-stack overhead caused old measurements.

header_change.old: Fill precedes independent tile-row copies; image index follows grid C order.
header_change.new:
Each worker owns complete output rows; padding and unused tiles are filled,
// while occupied tile spans are copied directly in grid C order.
header_change.invariant: Every struct/signature/ABI token and all stable POD, disjointness, valid span, worker and no-FP/no-allocation requirements stay exact. SDK review permits only this header comment hash delta plus the archive; compare comment-stripped header token streams.

unchanged: All Python frontend/provider/decorator order and binder
Public structs/signatures and private montage.hpp forwarding header
All original captures/factories/observers/71 native fixture records
All nine benchmark cases/input generation/warmup/calibration/rounds/timed public boundary
Every closed report, decision and tolerance
algorithm: Early return for zero output bytes before reading fill/input. Positive output with no images or zero input tile height/width becomes fill-only, preserving null input permissions.
Compute byte-pattern zero flag once, snapshot workers supplied by caller, partition complete output rows using existing partition and parallel_min. No pool or validation changes.

For each output row identify padding versus a tile row once. Fill full padding/unused rows. Within occupied rows copy active tile spans directly, fill leading/intertile/trailing holes only; each output byte is written once.
Reuse a local fill-span operation across full rows and holes: zero memset or exact pixel-pattern memcpy doubling, always whole pixels and disjoint initialized spans. No floating loads/arithmetic.

Preserve signed image/row/column/channel strides and unaligned POD reads. Contiguous rows use existing memcpy. Single-channel itemsize4 strided rows use fixed4-byte memcpy; eligible columnstride+8 AVX2 rows invoke the unchanged proven operation. Other POD widths/channels use existing exact byte copy routes.

Choose SIMD eligibility outside worker/row loops; the helper has no allocation, FP, private pool, Python or runtime-dispatch work. Scalar disable and portable builds retain the constant4-byte copy route.

simd_reuse.change: None in the proven 23-line function; no new kernel variant or expanded vector load span.

correctness.must_preserve: All old assertions and initial output stream prefix byte-exact in every mode. All four rounding modes/FP flags/global workers1,4/canaries/input mutation unchanged. No original calls.
real_additive_gaps: Single-channel itemsize4 +8 stride SIMD exact-span tails, widths around8/9/16/17/32 boundaries
Misaligned positive/negative input rows with constant4-byte copy and vector unaligned loads
Fill pattern aliases input storage while output stays disjoint
More incomplete-grid/unused-row and nonzero padding patterns at worker row boundaries above parallel threshold
correctness.test_scope: Only additive cases after the historical old loop so its stream prefix remains exact; reuse current independent output-centric oracle. No new mirror of the row-owned algorithm.

measurement.affinity: One initially permitted CPU selected once for all eight independent subprocess passes before imports.
measurement.source_products: A exact admitted247 base; B one fresh genuine prepare-only product. Same13 dependency wheel hashes and runtime identities. No build/test on timing host.
measurement.retention: All complete raw reports and losses retained; unchanged-measure launcher journals each returned dictionary outside timers, initial/final PID/affinity/exit/identity receipts. Unreturned current-measure samples unavailable.
measurement.estimators: Balanced baseline is geometric mean of all four A pass medians. Direct=GM(A CPP)/GM(B CPP); normalized=GM(B original/CPP)/GM(A original/CPP); each candidate pass compared to the same balanced A.

artifact/dispatch-contract.json.risk: Physical fill/copy scheduling changes only under unchanged stable/disjoint POD invariants; new row indexing, empty axes and unused-grid handling are the concrete correctness risks checked by immutable fixture/oracle streams. Speedup is unproven until same-host full-public measurement.

measurement_variance_rule.scope: Each of the eight non-target controls independently, separately for direct and normalized metrics. Inspect both same-product null pairs B2/B3 and A6/A7.
measurement_variance_rule.direct_null_ratio: Earlier CPP median / later CPP median for each same-product pair.
measurement_variance_rule.normalized_null_ratio: Later original/CPP ratio / earlier original/CPP ratio for each same-product pair.
measurement_variance_rule.if_either_null_ratio_outside_interval: Require worst observed A/B gain >=0.97 for THAT control and THAT metric. Otherwise UNRESOLVED_MEASUREMENT. No blanket null-band veto or relaxed floors.
measurement_variance_rule.worst_direct: min(all four A CPP pass medians) / max(all four B CPP pass medians)
measurement_variance_rule.worst_normalized: min(all four B original/CPP ratios) / max(all four A original/CPP ratios)
measurement_variance_rule.always_publish: All direct/reference/normalized null ratios, all A/B pass values and both worst-pair gains for every control.
measurement_variance_rule.invariants: All fixed balanced3% floors, RGB-first per-pass floors, target/global/original gates remain required. Large separated gains may pass despite observed null variance; do not label that measurement stable.
